chaining: mainland and overseas accounts have separate base URLs and keys, so usage and credit do not aggregate across regions

free_tier.stated: One-time free credits for all new and existing users, collected on the console Balance page, announced with the start of billing. No vendor page read states the amount of this credit. The promotions FAQ states that bonus credit from new user registration or Refer & Earn is currently valid for 40 days; the expiry of the January 2026 one-time credit itself is not stated. Calls deduct the complimentary free quota first and then the recharged balance, and an account with insufficient balance cannot use the API

limits.value: unverified: no vendor page read states the amount of the one-time free credit or the expiry of the January 2026 grant (one news site reports a figure received by one user); after the credit is used the account needs a recharged balance

binding_note: the one-time credit is the only free allowance and its size is unpublished on the page read

identity_cost.detail: overseas users register a Xiaomi account by email or by Google or Facebook sign-in; mainland users by mobile number or third-party sign-in. Real-name authentication applies to mainland users before recharging or buying a package, and overseas users recharge without it

reliability_note: an automatic keyword-based protection mechanism can block an account as abnormal usage until the vendor reviews it on request
confidence_note: the billing notice is dated January 23, 2026; whether the credit is still granted is unverified
